async def act(page):
    # Log in to Magento Admin
    # Use generic selectors for login form
    username_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Username", exact=False)
    await username_field.fill("admin")  # Assuming default username
    password_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Password", exact=False)
    await password_field.fill("admin123")  # Assuming default password
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Sign in", exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After login, navigate to the Customers page via the menubar link
    customers_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Customers", exact=False)
    await customers_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
